name: Samium of Ur-Ysar
source:
Samium of Ur-Ysar is a secret guest and patient of the Order of the Universal Panacea, who is being treated for his polycritical aging-related illnesses by the Inner Circle. He is one of very few proficient Egomancers still alive in the present, since the discipline was banned. Utsushikome of Fusai desperately wants to talk to him.

[From [url=https://everblossom.miraheze.org/wiki/Samium_of_Ur-Ysar]The Flower That Bloomed Nowhere Wiki[/url]]
